truth: CORE-01 remains closed as the canonical durable memory substrate.
CORE-02A-D remain implemented evidence; CORE-02 is incomplete and preserved with Success Memory still outstanding.

CORE-03 A-E are closed as a construction dependency at exact head f34833c24ff7ac57f082729ff3d8a8a5f975d265. That closure covers semantic job/profile/template/recipe/tool foundations only and does not imply DAW/provider reachability, discovery or hosting.
Global reselection chose CORE-04A because exact-revision authority binding is the narrowest trust primitive required before any future host/provider/Recipe execution can safely unlock.
CORE-04A is the only active increment. ActionIntent represents exact material fields and computes a stable SHA-256 intent fingerprint.
ApprovalBinding is created only from an explicit non-empty caller source reference and binds only to the exact current intent fingerprint.
Any material change makes the prior approval STALE. Data-category order is canonicalized so non-material ordering changes do not create false staleness.
AuthorityService performs preview, bind_approval and validate only. It has no execute/send/post/publish/mutate/charge API and grants no provider or host permission.
Provider execution, host mutation, transactions/rollback, network policy, credentials, cost authorization, private-data egress and team permissions remain downstream CORE-04 work.
REQ-SCOPE-150 discovery/hosting and all DAW adapters remain downstream; CORE-03 closure must not reopen them by adjacency.
Hosted exact-head execution for prior stacked heads remains UNOBSERVED where the connector is blind and is not converted to green.
